primary_splits.patient_source: Pinned HEST_v1_1_0.csv; global HEST patient IDs
primary_splits.limitations: Only four patients. Two train, one validation, one test; insufficient for publication-level inference.

protocol.ridge_selection: validation median gene Pearson, then lower validation MSE, then smaller alpha
protocol.mlp_selection: lowest validation MSE among four seed-0 candidates; early stopping on validation MSE
protocol.negative_controls: S2-50, NC1 label-row permutation and NC2 embedding-row permutation; primary-selected hyperparameters, separate seed-specific permutation; early stopping on unchanged validation patient
protocol.lopo: all four settings; B0, B1 and B2 seeds 0/1/2; fold-training-only feature and target scalers on frozen C0 values; primary-selected hyperparameters; fixed rounded median best epoch across primary B2 seeds
protocol.metrics_space: frozen C0 normalized target units, after inversion of additional C1 target scaler
protocol.constant_prediction_correlation: undefined (NaN), including B0; do not assign artificial zero correlation
protocol.variance_for_gene_maps: training log1p(raw counts) variance; high/median/lowest-positive within each frozen panel
protocol.test_access: No primary test cache loaded by fitting stage; evaluation begins only after SELECTION_LOCK.json is written
protocol.registry: append-only results/experiment_registry.csv; all fits including candidates are registered
protocol.resource_peak: process RSS sampled every 20 ms during fit/inference; includes arrays resident at start; no per-location biological replication claims

decision.coexpression_caution: Permutation controls retain coexpression; not independent proof of spatial fidelity
decision.visual_audit: Representative maps show nonconstant broad variation with regional attenuation; sparse low-variance failure retained
decision.recommendation: Review and proceed to separate C2 single-scale graph versus local averaging comparison; no C2 executed

local_binary_note: C1/models and C1/predictions are locally retained and hashed but excluded from Git; regenerate from frozen inputs/code if absent.
